title: Sample a project video
description: Keep an original reference copy and extract five frames at 0, 25, 50, 75 and 95% of the video. Samples support reference work; they are not full motion, speech or scene-cut analysis. Works with local uploads and imported engine outputs. Up to one hour and 256 MiB.
author: Viral Hit
